world.title: At least 30 houses of Awami members set on fire in Bangladesh
world.summary: In Dhaka, following the killing of two BNP leaders on Wednesday, 20 to 30 houses belonging to Awami League (AL) leaders and activists were set on fire. Reports indicate that over 50 houses and several shops associated with AL members were targeted. The incident highlights escalating tensions between political factions in Bangladesh amid ongoing unrest.

world.title: Israel’s Eisenkot invites Netanyahu’s party for coalition talks to form next government
world.summary: Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar Party has invited Netanyahu's Likud to coalition talks as Israel aims to establish a new government amid a lack of clear parliamentary majority. Eisenkot faces a 28-day deadline starting November 8, with a potential 14-day extension, to form the government. The Yashar Party is also engaging with other political groups in these discussions.

world.title: Burning Trucks, Blood On The Streets And Stadium Panic: Cartel Unleash Fury In Mexico After ‘El Chapo Isidro’ Arrest
world.summary: After the arrest of 'El Chapo Isidro,' cartel operatives launched violent attacks in Guasave, Mexico, targeting security forces with gunfire and explosives. The clashes resulted in chaos throughout the city, leading to panic in public spaces, including a stadium. At least eleven fatalities have been reported as violence escalates in response to the arrest.

business.title: AI Boom Forces Massive Investment in Power Grids Worldwide
business.summary: The surge in AI and data center growth is significantly increasing global electricity demand, projected to rise by over 10,000 TWh in the next decade. In response, utilities worldwide are compelled to invest hundreds of billions in upgrading power grids and developing new transmission infrastructure to ensure that electricity can efficiently reach demand hubs.

business.title: GTA 6 Becomes Latest BJP-Congress Battleground: How PM Modi's Post Triggered Political Meme War
business.summary: The announcement of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) for November 2026 has sparked a political meme war between India's BJP and Congress. The BJP highlights the 13-year gap since GTA 5's release in 2013 as symbolic of the transition from UPA to NDA governance. This timing has led to various political interpretations and reactions on social media platforms.

business.title: IIT Delhi graduate who joined Google to clear parents’ ₹1 crore debt wins praise
business.summary: Yash Garg, a 28-year-old IIT Delhi graduate, has garnered social media acclaim for prioritizing a high-paying job at Google over his startup aspirations. His decision was driven by a desire to help his parents repay debts exceeding ₹1 crore. Garg's story highlights his commitment to family support and financial responsibility, resonating with many online.

technology.title: GTA 6 players can make $14,000 without completing a single mission at this hidden warehouse
technology.summary: In GTA 6, players can earn $14,000 without completing any missions by utilizing a hidden warehouse. This feature offers an opportunity for players to build their cash reserves while starting a criminal empire. The game’s mechanics allow for alternative methods of earning money, catering to different play styles and preferences within the expansive virtual world created by Rockstar Games.

technology.title: Best GTA 6 Weapons, Ranked by Class
technology.summary: The article ranks the best weapons in Grand Theft Auto VI by class, detailing their damage, handling, stats, and locations. It emphasizes the importance of selecting effective weapons for both free-roaming and story missions. With over 100 weapons available, the guide aims to help players identify which options are most valuable for gameplay efficiency and effectiveness.

technology.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
technology.summary: Microsoft has reported a data breach due to a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service. Attackers exploited this flaw to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. The company is advising organizations to take precautionary measures to secure their systems and protect sensitive data following this incident. Further details on the breach are pending.

sports.title: Messi, Miami staring at early exit after Columbus Game 1 rout
sports.summary: Inter Miami and Lionel Messi are at risk of an early exit from the MLS playoffs following a 3-0 defeat to the Columbus Crew in Game 1 of their first-round series. Gonzalo Tapia scored two goals for Columbus, contributing to Miami's challenging position as they aim to recover in the upcoming matches to stay in contention.

sports.title: Fighter jet gestures: Umpire celebrates with Pakistan team after controversial Asia Cup win; India questions neutrality
sports.summary: The Cricket Association for the Blind in India (CABI) has raised concerns about the neutrality of a Pakistani umpire following a video showing him celebrating with the Pakistan team. The gestures he made appeared to mimic crashing aircraft, prompting India to question the umpire's impartiality during the recent Asia Cup match, which ended in controversy.

sports.title: Hazlewood doesn't speak to Khawaja: AUS pacer reveals team divide during Sandpapergate
sports.summary: Josh Hazlewood has disclosed his distant relationship with Usman Khawaja, stating they barely communicate despite years in the Australian team. He highlighted that the 2018 squad lacked cohesion, with notable divisions between batters and bowlers during the Sandpapergate controversy. Hazlewood's remarks coincide with Khawaja's recent comments regarding the team's dynamics during that challenging period.

health.title: Lung cancer is the world’s most commonly diagnosed cancer and the leading cause of cancer deaths: Oncologist explains 7 major risk factors, including smoking, second-hand smoke, air pollution and rado
health.summary: Lung cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer globally and the leading cause of cancer deaths, with an estimated 2.6 million new cases in 2024, accounting for 12.8% of all cancers. Key risk factors include smoking, second-hand smoke, air pollution, and radon exposure. Understanding these factors can help individuals reduce their risk of developing lung cancer.

health.title: Portugal patients take part in personalised melanoma vaccine trial
health.summary: Three patients at the Portuguese Institute of Oncology in Lisbon are participating in an international clinical trial for a personalized melanoma vaccine. The trial tests intismeran autogene (V940), an experimental mRNA therapy developed by Moderna in collaboration with Merck. This vaccine aims to treat melanoma rather than prevent infection, marking a significant advancement in cancer treatment research.

health.title: CCMB study targets fungus disease-causing form without stopping growth
health.summary: Scientists at CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) have identified two compounds that inhibit the filamentous form of Candida albicans, which is linked to infection, while allowing the fungus to continue growing. The lead compound demonstrated improved survival rates in mice, suggesting potential for therapeutic development against fungal infections without compromising fungal growth.

science.title: BepiColombo Arrives at Mercury
science.summary: The BepiColombo mission has successfully entered orbit around Mercury after an eight-year journey. This joint project by the European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency aims to study the planet's surface and magnetic field. The mission will provide valuable data to enhance understanding of Mercury's formation and evolution, contributing to broader knowledge of planetary science.

science.title: Scientists develop an AI-powered camera that detects approaching bears and automatically sprays a deterrent; a 30-day field trial recorded 3 successful interventions
science.summary: Scientists in Qinghai Province, China, have created an AI-powered camera system that detects approaching bears and automatically sprays a deterrent. During a 30-day field trial, the system was deployed at three sites, including a landfill and herders' residences, resulting in three successful interventions. The project aims to reduce human-bear conflicts in areas where bears pose potential threats.

science.title: NASA is offering $1 million to anyone who can solve one big problem standing in the way of building a human settlement on the Moon
science.summary: NASA is offering a $1 million prize to individuals who can solve a significant challenge related to establishing a human settlement on the Moon. The initiative aims to advance plans for sustained human activities near the lunar South Pole, envisioning habitats, rovers, and power systems. This effort reflects decades of imagination and research into lunar living conditions.
